newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: LITHUANIA - RADIO HEADLINES AT NOON - MAY 15.
newsitem.headline: LITHUANIA - RADIO HEADLINES AT NOON - MAY 15.

text.p: These were the main news headlines reported by Lithuania's radio M1 Plus at noon on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these reports and cannot vouch for their accuracy.
- The chairman of the Christian Democratic Union Kazys Bobelis said on Thursday that he will run in the country's presidential elections in December.
- Japanese Prime Minister Riutaru Hashimotu told President Algirdas Brazauskas in Tokyo that Japanese companies will invest in Lithuania.
- A radioactive metal cargo from Ukraine was seized in Klaipeda port on Wednesday.
